customItemData.name: SP Card: Dragoon
customItemData.desc: A storm-knight of the dragon court in gilded plate. His lances become Lightning Rods where they land: the sky strikes them again and again, rods near each other link into crackling fences, and Skyfall Dive overloads every rod at once. Requires Job Lv. 10.

customItemData.name: SP Card: Berserker
customItemData.desc: Fury made flesh, wielding twin blood-blades. Burns his own blood in a crimson aura and whirls both swords for as long as his mana lasts. Bloodthirst: basic attacks and Blade Whirl heal 10% of the damage they deal. Requires Job Lv. 20.
